apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Removes experimental frame generation and fixes a reproduced Settings navigation-path crash. Retains Metal 4 SDR/PQ/HLG rendering, HDR, sharpening, MetalFX upscaling, touch, pointer input and PiP. Old frame-generation preferences are ignored. Optimized Release build; 328 tests passed, zero failures, one hardware skip. iPad-sidebar and iPhone-tab-bar navigation regressions and Mac GPU checks passed. Physical-device streaming verification remains pending. Unsigned build for installer signing.
